In Healthcare & Life Sciences, applied ai & generative ai at achala soft covers the full lifecycle of enterprise intelligence: strategy and value mapping, platform build-out, model adaptation, retrieval architectures, multimodal systems, and the governance fabric that keeps every model auditable. That is the baseline pattern; the differentiator is what it connects to: enterprise ai strategy & roadmapping, generative ai platform engineering, llm fine-tuning & model operations — delivered on Driisti Smart Vision Glasses and Fleet Management System and EEMS Platform with the sector's regulatory posture built in.

items: Physicians spend hours daily on notes, orders and inbox; burnout drives attrition. Documentation AI exists but stalls on integration with the EHR and on compliance sign-off.
Radiology and pathology queues grow while reporting stays manual; AI triage exists but sits outside the clinical workflow, so nobody acts on it.
Prior auth, coding and denial management consume staff across payer-provider boundaries. Denials arrive for documentation that existed but was never surfaced.
